integrity: Analytical arbitrary-dimensional proof and finite exact-rational verification. Independent mathematical review and historical-priority certification were not performed.
scientific_limitations: The metric is the inherited Euclidean metric in the canonical Loday coordinates, and the formula concerns distance to the known vertex barycenter rather than the global circumcenter. It determines the first two distinct vertex-radius shells, not every higher occupied shell. Historical priority is provisional.
title: A four-unit radial gap and a branching-defect identity for Loday's associahedron
